audio.notes: Silent screencast sample. Visual pacing and text overlays carry the demo.

screencast.pacing: Deliberate pointer movement, visible waits after state changes, and short text cards between capture scenes.

scenes.description: Open the screencast with a short title card.
Screencast the clean chat state, create a new chat, then restore the saved Launch Plan conversation.
events: Navigate to the chat app and wait for the first frame to settle.
Click the New chat button.
Wait for the chat status to show that a new chat is ready.
Confirm the previous conversation history is cleared.
Click Launch Plan Chat.
Confirm the saved conversation history is restored.
Pause long enough for the restored state to read clearly in the screencast.

scenes.description: Briefly introduce the message composition capture.
Screencast a typed prompt, submit it, and hold on the deterministic assistant response.
events: Create a new chat.
Type a short user message with visible human-paced typing.
Click Send.
Wait for the user message to appear.
Wait for the assistant response to appear.
Hold on the completed transcript so the response can be read.

scenes.description: Briefly introduce the saved-chat review portion of the screencast.
Screencast the saved chat hover state with enough dwell time for the action hint to read.
events: Navigate to the chat app and wait for the saved chat list to settle.
Hover over the archived Launch Plan chat item.
Wait for the hover action hint to appear.
Hold on the highlighted chat item.

scenes.description: Screencast a smooth transcript scroll from recent checklist content back to the first welcome message.
events: Navigate to the chat app and wait for the transcript to settle.
Smoothly scroll down inside the message transcript.
Wait for the final checklist message to be visible.
Smoothly scroll back to the top of the message transcript.
Wait for the first welcome message to be visible.

scenes.description: Close with a static screenshot of the chat app and a clear call-to-action overlay.

image.alt: Screenshot of the Barebones Chat app showing saved messages and the message input.
